# Ivan Balasi

> Web developer and designer with 20+ years of experience. Senior Manager, Web Development · Photography & Media at NYU Grossman School of Medicine's Office of Science & Research (NYU Langone Health). Builds websites, intranet sites, web apps and AI chatbots, and handles photography, graphic design, video and podcasts. Available for freelance web, photography and design work.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://ivanbalasi.com/): Overview, selected web work and other practices
- [Web work](https://ivanbalasi.com/work.html): 21 projects: websites, intranets, AI chatbots, web apps (including EaseSignature, an e-signature platform), freelance and archive projects
- [Rutgers case study](https://ivanbalasi.com/case-rutgers.html): Video platform for early childhood educators, from research and wireframes to launch
- [Graphic design](https://ivanbalasi.com/design.html): Event posters, flyers, booklets, banners and infographics
- [Photography](https://ivanbalasi.com/photography.html): Headshots, events, faculty portraits, lab, portrait, wedding, sports and street photography
- [Video & podcast](https://ivanbalasi.com/media.html): Office of Science and Research videos, The Clinical Research Podcast Series and Graduate School Insider
- [About](https://ivanbalasi.com/about.html): Bio, career path, toolkit and quick answers
